processDescription: Chemical passivation of titanium per ASTM B600 removes surface contamination (embedded iron, heat tint) and restores the natural passive oxide layer. The nitric-hydrofluoric acid bath preferentially dissolves contaminant particles without attacking the base titanium, specifically for titanium components. Precision titanium components present unique challenges: balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM) is optimized for each feature.
heatControl: Solution at 50–60°C with acid concentration monitored by titration. Parts fully immersed with agitation for uniform exposure.
flatnessControl: Chemical process — no mechanical force. Dimensional stability maintained.
capabilitiesDescription: Surface engineering capability for Surface blasting / passivation, with process control, bath chemistry monitoring, and batch consistency validation.
